subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review or adopt the open fork PR for this issue, or close that path and ask for a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The issue remains source-reproducible on current main, but an open linked fork PR already carries the focused resolver/test change, so starting another automated fix would risk duplicating active implementation work.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing proof if needed.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close or ignore the fork path and ask for a same-repository PR with the same UI-only resolver behavior and regression tests.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing proof if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger introduced the channel UI metadata catalog and is the strongest history signal for deciding whether the UI should merge loaded custom channels with built-in discovery cards.
